tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE+ 48V 0.65A (30W) PoE+ Adapter is a high-quality power injector designed to provide reliable power to PoE-enabled networking devices. Delivering 48V DC at 0.65A with a maximum output of 30W, this PoE+ adapter simplifies installations by transmitting both power and data over a single Ethernet cable. It is an ideal solution for powering UniFi access points, IP cameras, VoIP phones, wireless bridges, and other IEEE 802.3at PoE+ compatible devices.

Designed for dependable performance, the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE+ Adapter features advanced protection against surge, electrostatic discharge (ESD), overcurrent, and short circuits, ensuring the safety of connected devices. Its compact, lightweight design makes it easy to install in offices, homes, retail stores, hotels, schools, and enterprise environments. With Plug-and-Play functionality, deployment is fast and hassle-free, requiring no additional configuration.

Whether you are expanding an existing UniFi network or installing new PoE devices, the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE+ Adapter offers a cost-effective and reliable power solution. At D CORE, you can purchase the genuine Ubiquiti U-POE+ Adapter at the best price in Bangladesh with fast nationwide delivery and dependable customer support.

Key Features


  • Genuine Ubiquiti UniFi PoE+ Adapter
  • 48V DC output at 0.65A
  • Maximum 30W power output
  • Supports IEEE 802.3at PoE+ devices
  • Delivers power and data over a single Ethernet cable
  • Built-in surge, ESD, overcurrent, and short-circuit protection
  • Universal 100–240V AC input
  • Compact and lightweight design
  • Energy-efficient operation
  • Simple Plug-and-Play installation
